review_candidates.description: Job Description Background: UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security. The Regional Area of Women, Peace, Security and Humanitarian Action (WPS-HA) supports UN Women Country Offices across Latin America and the Caribbean in strengthening women's leadership and meaningful participation in peace, security and humanitarian action, while promoting gender-responsive approaches to emerging and protracted crises, recovery and reconstruction. The Area provides technical assistance, develops and implements regional initiatives, strengthens capacities, supports resource mobilization and partnerships, generates knowledge and promotes the positioning of WPS-HA priorities at regional and global levels. Within this context, the Programme Specialist provides specialized technical expertise and programme implementation support to advance the Humanitarian Action and Humanitarian-Development-Peace Nexus portfolio within the Women, Peace, Security and Humanitarian Action (WPS-HA) area, with a particular focus on resilience, preparedness, response, recovery and disaster risk reduction. Based in the Regional Office, the Programme Specialist plays a key role in strengthening and positioning these agendas across the region by supporting the design, implementation, monitoring and scaling up of gender-responsive programmes, initiatives and partnerships. The position provides strategic and technical guidance to Country Offices and regional stakeholders in contexts affected by crises, disasters, displacement, mobility and climate-related risks, while promoting synergies with the Women, Peace and Security agenda, peacebuilding processes and other priority areas of the regional portfolio. Reporting to the Regional Advisor, WPS-HA, the Programme Specialist is responsible for the technical planning, implementation, monitoring and management of assigned programmes, projects and initiatives within the WPS-HA area, and provides specialized technical advice to support linkages between humanitarian action, resilience, recovery, disaster risk reduction and Women, Peace and Security. The Programme Specialist will also support resource mobilization efforts, including the development of funding proposals and donor engagement materials, and contribute to the preparation of reports, knowledge products and evidence-based documents that respond to the strategic needs of the area, helping to advance the agenda, sustain ongoing initiatives and expand funding opportunities and partnerships. The position works in close coordination with members of the WPS-HA Area to ensure strategic coherence, complementarity, and synergies across the regional portfolio. Coordinate the implementation and management of assigned programmes, projects and initiatives Coordinate and oversee the technical implementation of assigned humanitarian action, resilience, recovery and disaster risk reduction programmes, projects and initiatives, ensuring quality, timely delivery and alignment with regional priorities. Identify and promote opportunities to strengthen linkages between humanitarian action, resilience, recovery, disaster risk reduction, climate action, Women, Peace and Security, peacebuilding and other relevant areas of the regional portfolio. Support in the adoption of global and regional guidance, standards, tools and methodologies to regional, national and/or local contexts, as appropriate. Build and maintain relationships with key regional and national partners to strengthen collaboration, knowledge exchange, and programme implementation. Facilitate cross-country learning, South-South cooperation, and the dissemination of good practices across the region. Build partnerships and support resource mobilization efforts Develop and strengthen strategic partnerships with governments, donors, UN entities, civil society organizations, academic institutions and other stakeholders to advance the humanitarian action and resilience agenda. Support the development and implementation of resource mobilization strategies for the WPS-HA Area. Identify funding opportunities and conduct donor mapping and analysis to support programme expansion and sustainability. Lead and contribute to the preparation of high-quality concept notes, project proposals (including annexes), budgets, donor reports, and partnership agreements. Develop evidence-based materials, strategic briefs, presentations, talking points, and business cases to support programme positioning, advocacy and resource mobilization efforts. Promote opportunities to integrate humanitarian action and resilience priorities into broader Women, Peace and Security, peacebuilding, climate and recovery-related funding initiatives. Contribute to regional intergovernmental and inter-agency coordination Provide technical support to the Regional Advisor and other relevant members of the WPS-HA Area on inter-agency and regional intergovernmental coordination related to Humanitarian Action, Resilience and HDP Nexus approaches, including through participation in meetings, events, groups and committees, drafting talking points, preparing presentations, as required. Contribute to inter-agency coordination on gender-responsive humanitarian action, resilience and HDP Nexus issues, including engagement with relevant UN entities, humanitarian and development partners, government institutions, donors and civil society organizations. Identify opportunities for collaboration and joint initiatives that strengthen linkages between humanitarian action, resilience, recovery, development and peacebuilding, as relevant to the regional context. Manage advocacy, knowledge building and communication efforts Develop and review technical guidance, background documents, briefs, presentations and other knowledge of products related to Humanitarian Action, Resilience, Recovery and Disaster Risk Reduction. Represent UN Women in meetings, technical and policy dialogues on issues related to Humanitarian Action, Resilience and Recovery, as necessary. Develop advocacy strategies and oversee their implementation in support of the Humanitarian Action and Resilience portfolio. Identify best practices and lessons learned to guide programme improvement, strategic planning and knowledge generation. Develop knowledge management strategies, products and methodologies on gender-responsive Humanitarian Action, Resilience and related HDP Nexus approaches. Experience in the usage of computers and office software packages

review_candidates.description: Description Job Title: Systems Commissioning Engineer Department: Automation Implementation Location: Remote - Travel Employment Type: Full Time The Systems Commissioning Engineer is responsible for leading the final integration, testing, troubleshooting, validation, and operational readiness activities for automated material handling and warehouse automation systems prior to customer acceptance and go-live. This role comes in near the end of a project and helps run the system through its full operational paces. The position verifies that system components function together as designed, identifies issues that could affect startup or customer operations, and coordinates feedback and issue resolution with the appropriate internal teams and third-party vendors. The Systems Commissioning Engineer acts as the final technical integrator between installation, controls, software, robotics, AGV/AMR vendors, project management, and customer operations. The role does not replace PLC engineering, software development, or vendor technical support. Instead, it ensures that issues are found, documented, routed, prioritized, and verified before the system is turned over to the customer. Overall Responsibilities Commissioning and Startup Lead on-site commissioning activities for automated warehouse and material handling systems. Execute startup plans for conveyors, sorters, palletizing systems, ASRS, robotic cells, AGV/AMR systems, safety systems, and third-party equipment. Verify that controls, software, mechanical equipment, networking, and customer-facing operating workflows function together as an integrated system. Support initial production ramp-up and go-live activities. Testing and Validation Develop, maintain, and execute commissioning checklists, functional test scripts, and site acceptance test procedures. Perform device verification, I/O validation, functional testing, failure recovery testing, stress testing, and throughput validation. Validate system behavior against project requirements, operational expectations, and agreed acceptance criteria. Confirm that fixes are implemented and retested before issue closure. Troubleshooting and Issue Isolation Diagnose issues across mechanical, electrical, controls, software, robotics, networking, and integration layers. Reproduce problems, isolate likely root cause areas, and clearly communicate required action to the correct owner. Coordinate escalation to PLC, software, mechanical, robotics, AGV/AMR, WMS/WCS, and other vendor teams as needed. Identify operational workarounds when appropriate while permanent corrections are being completed. Issue Management and Documentation Create and maintain commissioning punch lists, issue logs, defect summaries, and action item trackers. Document observed behavior, steps to reproduce, screenshots or logs where applicable, business impact, root cause updates, corrective actions, and verification status. Prioritize issues based on safety, go-live impact, operational disruption, customer impact, and schedule risk. Provide recurring commissioning status updates to project stakeholders. Cross-Functional Coordination Serve as a technical bridge between Project Management, Controls Engineering, Software, Mechanical Engineering, Installation, Lifecycle Services, customers, and equipment vendors. Coordinate issue ownership and resolution without becoming the default owner for every fix. Support customer readiness discussions and help confirm the system is prepared for operational turnover. Feed lessons learned back into future project standards, test plans, templates, and commissioning processes. Knowledge & Skills Requirements Education and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, Automation, Industrial Technology, or related field preferred. Equivalent experience in automation, controls, material handling, warehouse systems, or field commissioning may be considered. 3 or more years of experience in automation, systems integration, field startup, controls, software implementation, equipment commissioning, or warehouse automation preferred. Technical Knowledge Working understanding of PLC-controlled equipment, HMI systems, electrical devices, sensors, motors, VFDs, safety circuits, and industrial networks. Familiarity with warehouse automation systems such as conveyor, sortation, ASRS, robotic palletizing, picking systems, AGVs, AMRs, scanners, scales, and label print/apply equipment. Ability to interpret electrical drawings, mechanical layouts, controls documentation, sequence of operations, test plans, and system requirements. Experience working with WMS, WCS, WES, ERP, robotics, or third-party vendor interfaces is a plus. PROFESSIONAL QUALITIES Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to separate symptoms from likely root causes. Clear written and verbal communication skills, especially when documenting issues and communicating across technical disciplines. Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-moving project startup environment. Customer-facing professionalism and ability to remain calm during go-live pressure. Strong attention to detail, follow-through, and documentation discipline. WORK CONDITIONS Regular travel (75%) to customer project sites is expected, particularly during commissioning, startup, SAT, and go-live phases. Work may occur in active construction, installation, distribution center, manufacturing, or warehouse environments.
